Specification: This module specifies Fischer's timed mutual exclusion algorithm for N synchronizing processes, together with a separate ticking process that decrements per-process timers. The specification is written as a PlusCal algorithm with an included TLA+ translation, and it models timing using constants Delta and Epsilon plus a large sentinel value Infinity. It checks a mutual exclusion invariant, states a liveness property saying that some process is infinitely often in the critical section, and includes a TLC-based check of named state counts. The comments explicitly note that a bug should be found when N > 1 and Delta >= Epsilon, highlighting the timing-sensitive design of the algorithm.
AssumptionNames:
/\ Print("Testing Fischer's Mutual Exclusion Algorithm", TRUE)
       /\ Print(<<" Number of processes = ", N>>, TRUE)
       /\ Print(<<" Delta   = ", Delta>>, TRUE)
       /\ Print(<<" Epsilon = ", Epsilon>>, TRUE)
       /\ Print("Should find a bug if N > 1 and Delta >= Epsilon", TRUE)
IfThenElse:
IF x # self
                 THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "c"]
                 ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"]

IF timer[i] < Infinity
                                THEN timer[i] - 1
                                ELSE timer[i]
FunctionConstructor:
[i \in 1..N |-> IF timer[i] < Infinity
                                THEN timer[i] - 1
                                ELSE timer[i] ]
StringLiterals: Should find a bug if N > 1 and Delta >= Epsilon
